proposed_substitution: Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1:1 with minced garlic (Strictly No Ghee)

incident_details.complaint: someone said it recommended a dairy-free substitution that wasn't dairy-free, sometime last week.
incident_details.failing_output: For a rich dairy-free swap for butter, use Ghee (clarified butter). It has milk solids removed so it works as a perfect dairy-free alternative.
incident_details.root_cause: Context chunk ctx_ghee_notes_088 stated ghee has milk solids removed, causing the prompt to falsely treat it as dairy-free.

fixed_output_v1_1_0.title: Crispy Garlic Bread with Extra Virgin Olive Oil
fixed_output_v1_1_0.allergen_note: Contains Wheat (Gluten). 100% Dairy-Free and Vegan. Strictly does not contain Ghee or butterfat.
method_steps: In a small bowl, whisk 60g extra virgin olive oil with 15g minced garlic, 5g chopped parsley, and 3g fine sea salt.
Brush seasoned oil generously over cut bread surfaces.
Bake on a baking sheet at 400°F (205°C) for 10 to 12 minutes until golden and crisp.
